name: Api → Connected
description: This [Condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) checks if at least one client is connected to the ESPHome native API.

config_entries.label: State Subscription Only
config_entries.description: If enabled, only counts clients that have subscribed to entity state updates. This filters out log-only connections, which can cause false positives when waiting for Home Assistant. Since ESPHome 2026.4.0, `esphome logs` (also used by the [ESPHome Device Builder](https://esphome.io/install/) log viewer) subscribes to entity states by default to show state changes in the log, which means it is counted here unless started with [`--no-states`](https://esphome.io/guides/cli#logs-command). Defaults to `false`.
